title: cryoblob: Particle Picking of Cryo-EM Datasets
description: JAX-based, JIT-compiled package for detecting amorphous blobs in low-SNR cryo-EM images. Reference-free Laplacian-of-Gaussian particle picking with an FFT-based scale-space detector, an optional LoG+watershed pass for overlapping particles, adaptive (gradient-descent-tuned) preprocessing, and a differentiable response field.
